Ana (CS Ops): Hey team — quick ask. We need a one-off healthscore snapshot for the renewal cohort (contracts renewing in next 90 days) and a short audit of playbook triggers that fire on stale contacts. Goal: identify accounts with high churn risk but low recent activity + stale contact info.
Ravi (CS): +1. Can we add retention_signal and enablement_completed as features? they should help separate risky from healthy.
Jess (CS Tooling): I can wire that up in the playbook engine. Planning to add a pre-check that skips accounts with enablement_completed = true. Will open a PR.
Miguel (Data Eng): I wrote a quick query to surface stale contact + low activity. Use with caution (sampled results).
Miguel (Data Eng): ```sql
-- stale contacts, low activity, renewal in 90 days
SELECT account_id, last_touch, contact_email, health_score, retention_signal
FROM account_facts
WHERE renewal_date BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '90 days'
  AND (last_touch IS NULL OR last_touch < now() - interval '120 days')
  AND activity_30d < 5
ORDER BY health_score ASC
LIMIT 500;
```
Olivia (CS Manager): Good. Also surface accounts that are in Dedicated/Dedicated+Private tiers — those are high priority for success team outreach.
Jess (CS Tooling): Will add a route to the playbook filter: tier IN ("Dedicated", "Private") before enqueue. Also adding a small debounce so we don't re-fire the same playbook within 7 days.
Ravi (CS): Any quick checks on email validity? lots of stale emails cause bad outreach.
Miguel (Data Eng): We have an existing table contact_validation with last_bounced, mx_check. I'll join it in. Quick snippet: ```sql
LEFT JOIN contact_validation cv ON cv.contact_id = cf.contact_id
WHERE cv.last_bounced IS NULL AND cv.mx_ok = true
```
Ana (CS Ops): Awesome. For the snapshot, can playbook-bot run a sampling job and drop a CSV into s3 path: s3://redwood-cs/healthsnapshots/renewal-90d/<date>/ ? Need it by EOD PT.
Jess (CS Tooling): I can add a cron job and a one-off button in console to trigger the sampling. Proposed cron YAML for the sandbox run: ```yaml
schedule: "0 02 * * *" # 02:00 UTC daily
job: healthscore_snapshot
params:
  cohort: renewal_90d
  sample_size: 1000
  include_contact_validation: true
```
playbook-bot: Scheduled run queued (run_id: hp-2026-03-21-7f3) — ETA ~12 minutes. CSV will land at s3://redwood-cs/healthsnapshots/renewal-90d/2026-03-21/hpsample.csv
Olivia (CS Manager): Please tag any accounts with "manual outreach" if health_score < 30 and enablement_completed = false. We'll prioritize those tomorrow morning.
Ana (CS Ops): Copy that. Jess — once PR is up, can you drop the link here? I want to run the snapshot against the branch before merging.
Jess (CS Tooling): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cs-playbooks/pull/482 — adds enablement flag and debounce. Please review.
Ravi (CS): Quick QA: sample looks good so far, noticed a weird spike where activity_30d = 0 but health_score = 55. Might be data staleness or custom overrides.
Miguel (Data Eng): If there are manual overrides we should expose override_reason in the snapshot. I'll add that column.
